entities.name: 5GSM-INACTIVE
entities.description: Initial state of the 5GSM sublayer in the UE when no 5GSM context is established.

entities.name: 5GSM-ACTIVE
entities.description: State of the 5GSM sublayer in the UE when a 5GSM context is established and PDU sessions are active.

entities.name: 5GSM context established
entities.description: Property indicating that the UE has established a 5GSM context with the network.

entities.name: PDU sessions active
entities.description: Property indicating that the UE has active PDU sessions.

relations.description: Transition from 5GSM-INACTIVE to 5GSM-ACTIVE state establishes the 5GSM context.
5GSM-ACTIVE state requires that a 5GSM context is established.
5GSM-ACTIVE state requires that PDU sessions are active.
